create_SymbolicAlchemyWrapper: create a SymbolicAlchemyWrapper instance wrapping a 3D alchemy environment with a symbolic environment in sync
run_process_step_events: run process_step_events to parse 3D environment events and update the symbolic environment state
run_step: run step on the SymbolicAlchemyWrapper to take an action in the 3D environment and sync symbolic state
run_reset: run reset on the SymbolicAlchemyWrapper to reset both the 3D and symbolic environments and clear trial state
review_add_observations: review add_observations to merge symbolic observations into the 3D environment timestep before returning
